english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to describe someone confident in their own abilities.

examples.english: 阿明 has always been self-confident and never gets nervous speaking in front of people.
examples.traditional: 阿明由細到大都好有自信，喺人哋面前講嘢從來唔怯。
